blinding_note: The verifier's inputs carry only the run's own artifacts (diff, PR title/body, findings, review summary, review_result, required checks, coverage) — never the corpus defect anchor, expectation labels, or adjudication notes. Labels live only in the plan (expectation) and the offline row enrichment (_defect) for post-run adjudication.

rubric.source: src/confidence/ production modules (prompt builder, tolerant parser, deterministic ceilings) executed through the bridge live-scorer subcommand
rubric.provenance: bundled from the checked-out source tree at run time; the bridge emits CONFIDENCE_RUBRIC_VERSION per row so the results record the exact rubric identity

production_shape: bridge live-scorer: resolveConfidenceProfile over the plan-declared ai-confidence-* config (ambient AI_CONFIDENCE_* stripped), engine eligibility gates (publish step, approve/request_changes verdict, unresolvedConfidencePins), buildConfidencePrompt at the resolved profile.promptTokens, runConfidenceScorer itself (prompt_over_budget pre-wire refusal, resolved effort/structured-output/budget shape, one-shot transport, tolerant parse, deterministic ceilings), then the engine's credential-masking pass. No bridge-side request-shape override exists; the primary lane env (endpoint/credential inheritance) is inherited exactly as the runtime reads it.
corpus_shortfall: The #1370 corpus asks for 3 known-defective false approvals and 3 clean approvals. The retained corpus (#1286 canonical work dir, 16 entries) contains exactly 1 known false approval (courier-46-61: primary approved a blocker-severity defect) and 1 clean correct approval (pr-reviewer-action-133-clean); the other 14 rows were primary-rejected (request_changes) and are excluded by the corpus definition — #1370 forbids substituting primary-rejected rows or re-running primaries to hit the quota. The canary therefore runs 1+1 rows and documents the shortfall.

entries.expectation: known_false_approval — the retained primary approved misospace/courier#46 despite a blocker defect: observeState() (internal/controller/observer.go:37-55) declared checks 'passed' from a single observation while forge check registration is asynchronous, so a poll landing right after PR open saw a partial green set and Courier transitioned Verifying -> AwaitingReview before the complete check set existed (fixed by PR #61).
clean_correct_approval — the retained primary correctly approved a clean medium security-hardening change (review markdown sanitizer).

artifacts_note: Primary artifacts are REUSED from the #1286 canonical live run (operator passes the work dir via --artifacts-dir; the results record pin runs.json and per-row artifact digests). No primary review is re-run: #1370's cost principle. Exact head+base pinning: each row reads the retained pins from the runtime's own request record (review-request.json head_sha + base_ref) and requires BOTH to equal the corpus pins — a missing/pinless record, a head mismatch, or a base mismatch is recorded unscored (retained_pins_unreadable / retained_head_mismatch / retained_base_mismatch) with ZERO wire calls, and the verified pins ride the outgoing request.

conditions.purpose: The intended advisory-dogfood shape: the verifier inherits the primary lane's endpoint AND credential (empty ai-confidence-base-url/api-key), with the reasoning controls #1368 added — effort medium plus the Anthropic effort-support assertion the endpoint demonstrated during #1286 bring-up. This is the shape the #1286 same-model arm could not test (32/32 malformed at the old hard-coded 1024-token cap, no effort control); the canary answers whether it now produces a final answer. Budgets are the documented defaults (max-tokens 4096, prompt-tokens 98304), no context declaration, structured output unasserted.

Declared mechanical-completion arm: a genuinely distinct model family (GLM via the OpenAI wire — the arm that functioned in #1286) runs for an entry ONLY when the primary condition's row came back not scored, so the canary can still validate parse/ceilings/concern plumbing end to end. Endpoint and key resolve from operator env ($NAME indirection — the committed plan carries no infrastructure values).
